answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31765 Country: MU Title: interpretation of dream Question: My friend is a divorcee. She saw my husband in her dream and my husband was looking at her in her eyes. (When she told me about her dream, she told me she was surprised because my husband normally lowers his gaze when he talks to strangers). Answer ID: 31765 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 945/614/H=1432) Your divorcee friend seems to have less interest in following sunnah. She should pay special attention to it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
